how_chosen: Twenty public terms pages of API, cloud and SaaS vendors. Passages: the first sentence of 60-400 characters about refunds, fees, termination, deletion or notice in the page's visible text, as RedLine's own text rules extract it from a plain fetch on 23 October 2026, stored normalised. OpenAI and Notion are included although no passage could be taken from them, to record whether blocked and script-drawn pages ever read differently.
